summary: Frontend-only testing of HaulCheck edit-one-vs-all recurring calendar flows + Dashboard roster snapshot. Logged in as operator.test@example.com, ran a single Playwright script covering all 6 requested scenarios. Every assertion passed on the first attempt.

test_results.roster_snapshot: PASS — after adding 2 holidays on Tue 4 Aug, Dashboard 'Who's off this week' strip renders 7 roster-day cells. Tue cell shows both names (TEST_HolidayA, TEST_HolidayB), amber 'clash' indicator visible, summary reads '2 driver-days booked off'. Empty days show a dash.
test_results.recurring_edit_just_this_date: PASS — edit-scope selector (edit-scope-one/all) appears only for recurring items. Choosing edit-scope-one and changing title from TEST_WeeklyEvent to TEST_ChangedOne detached only the Aug 11 occurrence; all other weekly occurrences kept the original title.
test_results.recurring_edit_whole_series: PASS — edit-scope-all with title TEST_WholeSeries updated all remaining occurrences (Aug 18, 25, Sep 1, …) while the previously-detached Aug 11 stayed as TEST_ChangedOne (correct behaviour).
test_results.recurring_delete: PASS — clicking delete on a recurring occurrence opens the Dialog with delete-one and delete-all. delete-one removed only Aug 25; Sep 1 (and beyond) TEST_WholeSeries occurrences remained.
test_results.non_recurring_regression: PASS — editing TEST_NonRecurring did NOT render edit-scope. Deleting TEST_NonRecurring did NOT open the delete-scope Dialog (delete-one selector absent) — deleted directly.
test_results.reminder_recurrence: PASS — Reminder with reminder-recurrence=Monthly, when edited, shows the edit-scope selector (edit-scope-one/all) exactly like general events.

critical_code_review_comments: Calendar.js is ~745 lines and could be split (form dialog, delete dialog, chooser) for maintainability, but not blocking.

openEditEvent sets editScope default to 'all' for non-recurring items — safe because the scope UI is hidden and the saveEvent branch for non-recurring routes to PUT /events/{id} regardless, but consider making the default explicit for clarity.

renderEvent is shared between the sidebar list and the enlarged day Dialog, so edit/delete testids appear twice while both are open — tests must Escape the dialog first (already documented). Consider scoping edit/delete testids uniquely per surface.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_HolidayA, TEST_HolidayB, TEST_WeeklyEvent, TEST_ChangedOne (detached), TEST_WholeSeries (series rename), TEST_NonRecurring, TEST_ReminderMonthly in the operator.test account for the current week (Aug 2026). Not cleaned up — main agent can remove if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 edit-one-vs-all and roster-strip flows verified end-to-end via Playwright. Backend routes /calendar/events/{id}/occurrence (scope=one) and DELETE ?occurrence= confirmed working through the UI. If further changes touch Calendar.js openEditEvent / saveEvent branches, re-run the same script.
